probeReport.boundary: Prepared attempt with resident owners restored before every call; kernel totals exclude preparation, packing, reset, compilation, decoding and assertions. Reset totals reported separately. Diagnostic only; batching does not qualify timing.

boundary: Calling-thread malloc/calloc/realloc/free calls during synchronous callback, including call bridge and warmup; requested bytes, not live or peak allocation. No subtraction of empty control. Does not count aligned_alloc/mmap or direct __libc allocator bypasses.
